Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include<bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

void calculateTime (int n) 
{
  if (n == 0)
    cout << "Time Estimated : 0 Minutes";
  
  else if (n > 0 && n <= 2000)
    cout << "Time Estimated : 25 Minutes";
  
  else if (n > 2000 && n <= 4000)
    cout << "Time Estimated : 35 Minutes";
  
  else if (n > 4000 && n <= 7000)
    cout << "Time Estimated : 45 Minutes";
  
  else
    cout << "INVALID INPUT";
}

int main () 
{
  int Weight;
  cin >> Weight;
  
  calculateTime (Weight);
  return 0;

}
